description: This file defines a generic MaxHeap class implementation in C#, including internal classes and interfaces for heap elements, as well as a specific class for heap elements related to candidate vertices in a repartitioning context. It provides heap operations such as insert, pop, peek, and heapify, optimized for a quaternary heap structure.

classes.name: CandidateVertexHeapElement
classes.description: Represents a heap element associated with a candidate vertex, including transfer scores and connection information, used within the MaxHeap for prioritization.

classes.name: MaxHeap
classes.description: A generic, array-backed, quaternary max-heap implementation supporting typical heap operations and dynamic priority updates.

classes.name: IHeapElement
classes.description: An interface defining the properties and comparison method required for elements stored in the MaxHeap.

methods.name: MaxHeap
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the heap with a list of elements, performing heapify to establish heap order.

methods.name: Count
methods.description: Property that returns the number of elements in the heap.

methods.name: FirstOrDefault
methods.description: Returns the first element in the heap or default if empty.

methods.name: TryPeek
methods.description: Attempts to retrieve the maximum element without removing it.

methods.name: Peek
methods.description: Returns the maximum element without removing it; throws if heap is empty.

methods.name: TryPop
methods.description: Attempts to remove and return the maximum element.

methods.name: Pop
methods.description: Removes and returns the maximum element; throws if heap is empty.

methods.name: OnDecreaseElementPriority
methods.description: Adjusts heap position when an element's priority decreases.

methods.name: OnIncreaseElementPriority
methods.description: Adjusts heap position when an element's priority increases.

methods.name: Heapify
methods.description: Transforms an unordered list into a valid heap.

methods.name: MoveUp
methods.description: Restores heap order by moving an element up.

methods.name: MoveDown
methods.description: Restores heap order by moving an element down.
